Title 1: Restrict access to Finance and Operations environments with security groups
Description: Today every licensed user in the tenant is added to the Dataverse side of our Finance and Operations environments, including LVS-FO-PROD. The Power Platform admin center flags 13 environments for this. Attach Microsoft Entra security groups so only approved members can be users in each environment, and make a group mandatory for every new unified environment. Target: about four weeks to production. Done when: LVS-FO-PROD and all active environments that will be kept have a security group, with no unplanned loss of access or broken automation.

Agree group names, scope, and membership rules. Proposed: SG-D365FO-Prod for production and SG-D365FO-NonProd for test and development, with an optional SG-D365FO-UAT for acceptance testing. Week 1. Done when: design is agreed and recorded.

Title 3: Agree group names and scope (Prod / NonProd / optional UAT)
Description: Decide whether two groups are enough or acceptance testing needs its own group for business testers. Done when: group names and the environments each one covers are agreed.

Title 3: Decide static or dynamic membership for the production group
Description: A dynamic Entra group (for example, everyone with a Finance or Supply Chain license) keeps up with new hires but needs Entra ID P1. Confirm licensing, then choose. Members must be added directly: members of nested groups are not added to the environment automatically. Done when: membership approach is chosen for each group.

Title 3: Map in-scope environments to groups
Description: Flagged and active: LVS-FO-PROD, lvs-fo-acceptance, lvs-fo-ce-test, lvs-fo-testing-01, LVS-FO-STELLA-DEV, LVS-FO-UDE-AK, LVS-FO-USE-CONTOSO, LVS-FO-USE-SUPPORT-01, LVS-FO-USE-TEST-02, LVS-FO-USE-TSTDEP. Also decide on active environments the Actions page does not analyze because Managed Environments is off (LVS-FO-AK-02, LVS-FO-CE-TEST-Cloud, LVS-FO-CLN-TEST, LVS-FO-DEV-06, LVS-FO-DEV-12, LVS-FO-SUPPORT-DEV-3, LVS-FO-UDE-CE-DEV1, LVS-FO-UDE-CLN). Skip Lifecycle Services sandboxes due for retirement. Done when: every active environment is marked with a group or an explicit reason to skip.

Title 2: Build and approve the member list
Description: For each in-scope environment, list everyone who needs access, starting from users active there today. Week 1. Done when: functional leads have signed off the list for each environment.

Title 3: Export currently enabled users for each in-scope environment
Description: Pull enabled Dataverse users per environment (read-only query) as the starting member list. Done when: one list per environment is saved and shared with the functional leads.

Title 3: Inventory flow and connection owners
Description: User accounts that own flows or connections must be in the group or those automations stop. Includes the owner of the Client Data Export Processor flow in LVS-FO-PROD. Done when: every flow and connection owner in scope is on the member list or has an exception recorded.

Title 3: Identify service accounts, admins, partners, and testers
Description: Include service accounts that are ordinary user accounts, anyone with the Dynamics 365 Administrator role (not exempt), partner and consultant accounts including guests, and testers for sandboxes. Application users and Power Platform or Global Administrators are exempt. Done when: these accounts are on the relevant lists.

Title 3: Functional lead sign-off on member lists
Description: Finance, Supply Chain, and Customer Engagement leads review and approve the lists for their areas. Done when: written sign-off is recorded for each environment.

Title 2: Create the security groups in Microsoft Entra
Description: The identity team creates the groups and loads the approved members. Needs Groups Administrator or User Administrator. Week 2. Done when: groups exist and membership matches the signed-off lists.

Title 3: Create the cloud security groups
Description: Create SG-D365FO-Prod, SG-D365FO-NonProd, and SG-D365FO-UAT if agreed, as cloud security groups or Microsoft 365 groups. Groups synced from on-premises Active Directory are not supported. Done when: groups exist with owners and descriptions set.

Title 3: Load approved members and verify counts
Description: Add the signed-off members directly to each group. Done when: member counts match the approved lists.
Prove the change on one unified and one Lifecycle Services environment, since they behave differently. Week 2. Done when: every check passes and results are written up.

Title 3: Attach the NonProd group to LVS-FO-USE-SUPPORT-01 (unified)
Description: Power Platform admin center: Manage > Environments > select environment > Edit > Security group. Done when: the group is attached and users outside it are disabled as expected.

Title 3: Attach the NonProd group to lvs-fo-testing-01 (Lifecycle Services)
Description: Same steps as the unified pilot, on a Lifecycle Services-linked environment. Done when: the group is attached and users outside it are disabled as expected.

Title 3: Verify members can work and non-members are blocked
Description: Test with a member and a non-member. Check both the Dataverse side and the Finance and Operations web client: Microsoft's documentation does not make clear whether the web client is blocked. Done when: results are recorded for both environments.

Title 3: Verify dual-write, virtual entities, flows, and integrations
Description: Confirm integrations keep running, especially any that use a user account rather than an app registration. Done when: each integration in the pilot environments is confirmed working.

Title 3: Measure new-member sync time and rollback time
Description: Time how long a newly added member waits for access (Force Sync User is available if needed) and how long users take to regain access after the group is removed. Done when: both timings are recorded.

Title 3: Pilot write-up and go/no-go for rollout
Description: Summarize results, issues, and any plan changes. Done when: go/no-go decision is recorded.

Title 2: Roll out to the remaining environments
Description: Apply the NonProd group to the remaining active test environments in week 3, then the Prod group to LVS-FO-PROD in week 4 in a quiet window. Done when: production is restricted with no unplanned loss of access or broken automation.

Title 3: Apply the NonProd group to the remaining active sandboxes
Description: Environments from the mapping story, excluding the two pilots. After each, compare the users who lost access with what the list predicted. Done when: all mapped sandboxes have the group attached and verified.

Title 3: Set a governance contact in Managed Environments settings
Description: So users who are blocked see who to ask instead of a dead end. Done when: the contact appears in the blocked-user message.

Title 3: Communicate the production change to users
Description: Notify Finance and Operations users of the change window and how to request access. Done when: communication is sent at least one week before the window.

Title 3: Apply the Prod group to LVS-FO-PROD in the change window
Description: Attach SG-D365FO-Prod in the agreed quiet window, with the rollback steps from the pilot ready. Done when: the group is attached and smoke tests pass.

Title 3: Post-change review of disabled users and automations
Description: Review users disabled by the change and confirm flows, including Client Data Export Processor, still run. Done when: review is complete and any gaps are fixed.

Title 2: Build security groups into the unified migration
Description: Every new unified environment gets its security group when it is created, so it never goes through the disable-everyone step. Ongoing. Done when: assigning a group is a standard part of environment provisioning.

Title 3: Add a security group to the environment request and provisioning checklist
Description: Make the group a required field when requesting or provisioning a Finance and Operations environment. Done when: the checklist is updated and published.

Title 3: Pass --security-group-id in pac admin create scripts
Description: Update any Power Platform CLI provisioning scripts to set the group at creation. Done when: scripts are updated and tested on a new environment.

Title 3: Set up periodic access reviews of the groups
Description: Review group membership on a regular schedule (for example, Entra access reviews if licensed, or a quarterly manual review). Done when: the review schedule and owner are agreed.
